main_text.p: acta ne tum quidem ad rem ipsam, hoc est, ad ferendas abrogandasve leges accedebatur, sed ea tantum quæ istuc faciebant, quasi præparabantur. Nam referentibus proëdris decernebatur à populo, quo modo ac ordine nomothetis in actione futurâ sedendum, & unde sumendum argentum id, quod nomothetis iisdem pro navatâ reipublicæ operâ, erat solvendum. Hujus autem concionis convocatio si forte neglecta esset à prytanibus, ex lege Solonis mille drachmarum multam singuli Mi[illegible, ~2 letters]-nervæ pendere in arce jubebantur. At[illegible, ~2 letters] proëdri, ni statim post sacra peractâ[illegible, ~2 letters] in eâdem concione de nomothetis retulissent, ad pendendas eidem Dea[illegible, ~2 letters] drachmas XL (si non fallit vitiosa scrip-[illegible, ~2 letters]ptio, cum forte cccc pro xl scriben-[illegible, ~2 letters]dum) damnati quoque singuli habe-[illegible, ~2 letters]bantur. Utque hæ mulctæ sine vitio sc[illegible, ~2 letters]verentur, id curandum thesmothetis erat, reique ab iis, si esset opus, ad tri-[illegible, ~2 letters]bunal superius (Heliasticum intelligo) postulandi: qui si hoc negligerent, ut Areopago excluderentur, idem [illegible, ~2 letters]ἐσχατο[?]-præcipiebat. Cum ventum tandem ad rem esset, nomothetæ re antè benè deliberatâ auditisque syndicis, de quibus dictum, in concione legitimè coactâ suis locis sedentes ab epistatâ concionis

page.notes: Right margin: the marginal notes are cut off and nearly illegible; the marks shown as [illegible] are approximate placements against the lines. "Dea" at the end of line 17 may be the start of "Deæ" (the word continues as "drachmas" on the next line); the scan shows no hyphen. Greek word at line 26 is doubtful ([?]). Long s is rendered as plain s throughout; the page number printed as "ss" (55) is given as "ss". Possible printing errors left as printed: "cccc pro xl", "solvendum." with a stray mark, and "reiqueab" as one word, which is given as "reique ab".
